_: The photo manifest (landing v2 §8, built in tanda C / C7). One row per photo that the site uses: slug (the name the code asks for), file (the original in --src), and alt text in both locales. The originals live OUTSIDE the repo — ~/Desktop/osppy-fotos by default — and .gitignore blocks *.jpg under public/photos so an 91 MB folder can never be committed by accident. Run: node scripts/optimize-photos.mjs [--src <dir>]. NO credits file: the Unsplash and Pexels licenses both ASK for attribution and neither requires it, and the operator ruled on 2026-09-03 that the site carries none (HQA-D78). The author slug and the photo id stay in `file` here, which is where traceability belongs.
